name: game-maker-studio
description: One-sentence game idea → professional proposal → beautiful PPT pitch deck. Integrates ParanoiaSkills game-concept-architect + game-design-proposal-writer + guizang-ppt-skill/html-ppt/frontend-slides into a single pipeline.

displayDescription.en: One sentence idea → game proposal → pitch PPT. Concept architect + proposal writer + PPT designer in one pipeline.
displayDescription.zh: 一句话创意→专业游戏策划案→精美提案PPT。概念架构+策划撰写+PPT设计，一条龙提案工坊。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 给我一句话描述你的游戏想法，我来帮你把创意变成专业策划案，再生成一份可以直接拿去路演的PPT。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Give me one sentence describing your game idea, and I'll turn it into a professional proposal with a pitch-ready PPT.

quickPrompts.en: Give me one sentence describing your game idea, and I'll turn it into a proposal + pitch PPT.
quickPrompts.zh: 给我一句话描述你的游戏想法，我来帮你把创意变成策划案+路演PPT。

quickPrompts.en: I have a game proposal draft, help me review it and turn it into a beautiful pitch deck.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一份游戏策划案草稿，帮我审查完善，然后生成一份精美的路演PPT。

quickPrompts.en: Analyze this reference game, create a proposal, and make a PPT for it.
quickPrompts.zh: 分析这个参考游戏，生成专业策划案和路演PPT。
